title: Post Acute Care.
hero.text: 24/7 inpatient care with expert medical supervision, nursing support, and rehabilitation services tailored to your recovery.

overview: Post-acute care is designed for patients recovering from stroke, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, major surgery, road traffic accidents and other acute medical events that affect mobility, function and independence.

conditions.title: Neuro Rehabilitation
conditions.text: Tailored rehabilitation for neurological conditions affecting movement, cognition, balance and daily function.

conditions.title: Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation
conditions.text: Rehabilitation supports musculoskeletal injuries, chronic  and post-surgical limitations affecting movement and strength.

conditions.title: Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
conditions.text: Rehabilitation programs that promote safe recovery, restore mobility and reduce complications after surgery.

conditions.title: Accident Rehabilitation
conditions.text: Multidisciplinary rehabilitation for patients recovering from trauma-related injuries following road traffic accidents, work injuries, and life changing injuries.
